items.title: FedEx, Stock Of The Day, Eyes Buy Point — And A High-Margin Pivot
items.summary: FedEx is IBD Stock Of The Day after streamlining its parcel delivery and logistics businesses. Intraday, FDX stock eased near a buy point. In 2026, the Memphis-based company has shifted away from consumer parcel delivery to target higher-margin, business-to-business segments.

items.title: UPS Commits More Than $2 Billion to Expand Global Logistics Network
items.summary: UPS (NYSE:UPS) is investing more than $2 billion across its International, Healthcare and Supply Chain Solutions operations as the logistics group expands infrastructure and services across Europe, Asia-Pacific and the Americas. The investment programme began in 2024 and is expected to run through 2028, with UPS directing capital towards new logistics hubs, healthcare capabilities, freight infrastructure and international air connections.
